levels.title: Phonk God
story: Bass rattles the floor as strobe lights freeze the sweat in midair.
DJ Montagem stares down from the booth, ready to harvest your remaining aura.

opponent.name: DJ Montagem
opponent.persona: Brazilian phonk maestro radiating absolute main character energy from the booth.

taunts: You are completely cooked by this 808 drop.
One slip and your sigma streak snaps instantly.
My kick drum just erased ten thousand aura.

announcer.intro: The bass drops, fight for the dance floor.
announcer.win: Massive W, you cleared the entire booth.
announcer.lose: Cooked on beat, step off the stage.

levels.title: Corporate Synergy God
story: The 2am metro platform echoes with empty buzzwords.
Kevin adjusts his branded lanyard and challenges your vibe.

opponent.name: Kevin from Marketing
opponent.persona: Overcaffeinated intern flexing negative aura and secondhand buzzwords.

taunts: Frerot, your beat drop lacks pure synergy.
Let us circle back, you total NPC.
My rhythm roadmap has maximum rizz.

announcer.intro: Lanyard on, thinks he has main character energy.
announcer.win: Massive W, you sent him back to HR.
announcer.lose: Unbelievable L, outpaced by an unpaid intern.

levels.title: Sauce Boss
story: Neon lights flicker over sizzling spit at 4am.
Mehdi Aura spins the tongs without blinking.

opponent.name: Mehdi Aura
opponent.persona: Late night grillmaster with effortless main character energy.

taunts: T'es cuit, extra onions won't save you.
My spit spins faster than your delulu combo.
Too much sauce, your rhythm got ratioed.

announcer.intro: Midnight snack battle, clock in for pure aura.
announcer.win: Massive W, you earned the chef's special.
announcer.lose: You got chopped up by the grillmaster.

levels.title: Aura Saint
story: Dawn breaks over Notre-Dame as supreme stillness approaches.
His motionless presence radiates impossible main character energy.

opponent.name: His Holiness
opponent.persona: A serene presence exuding pure main character energy.

taunts: Receive this peaceful W for your soul.
May your inner rhythm find true peace, friend.
Breathe gently, your aura is completely restored.

announcer.intro: Dawn breaks, face the ultimate aura test!
announcer.win: Massive W, you have been absolved.
announcer.lose: Rest now, your rhythm was completely cooked.

levels.title: Algorithm Breaker
story: The feed detects zero retention in your rhythm.
Survive the sudden patch note before you vanish.

opponent.name: The Algorithm
opponent.persona: Cold corporate feed engine that has killed more than 2,000 prototypes this year.

taunts: Phase two drops down, your frame rate collapses.
It is giving zero engagement, strictly unindexed.
Massive L on retention, terminating feed access.

announcer.intro: Final feed gatekeeper approaches, show main character energy.
announcer.win: Infinite aura unlocked, you broke the entire feed!
announcer.lose: Shadowbanned forever, total loss of user momentum.
